class_config.name: crypto_accelerator
class_config.class_tree_node_basis: 'Algorithm data-path plus a SW-accessible register interface, no external protocol' against 'self-contained crypto block (no external protocol; register IO)' is an exact match.
class_config.description: ORGANIC #542 — Cryptographic accelerator IP: hardware implementation of AES, SHA, HMAC, ECC, ChaCha or similar. Typically pairs an algorithm data-path with a SW-accessible register interface for key loading, control, and status. Distinguishable by algorithm-domain vocabulary (encrypt/decrypt, key schedule, S-box, digest, IV/nonce) plus register-map features. Takes priority over bus_peripheral when crypto algorithm evidence is present.
